commits.message: fix(feed): a frame armed after it fell due is late from the moment it fell due, and §17 reads A-5 strictly (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.bwr)
fix(stats): a percentile reads the value its bucket stands for, never one rounded below it, and §17 states only what its readings support (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.bwr)

fix(stats): one duration histogram reads every timing, a feed logs its histograms once when it closes, and A-5 is judged at the rate it names (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.bwr)

- Every timing is recorded and read through one module: microseconds in a
  packed HdrHistogram, read as one Durations shape the stats snapshot and the
  feed's summary both spell. A percentile never reads above the max.
- A running feed summary states its distributions without the encoded
  histograms; the closing summary alone writes them, so a merge of closing
  summaries counts each frame once and the log grows once per feed.
- The stats snapshot's `took` says it is the render event's, refusals included.
- Spec §17: A-5 stands at 30 fps, the rate it names, and frames fall short at
  60; lateness is said to include the draw; A-1's open item is owned by `cwq`.
docs(spec): A-1 stands at 30 fps and falls at 60, A-5 stands at both, read from real use (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.bwr)
feat(stats): every timing candybar reports is a percentile of an HdrHistogram of every value: render times, launches by category and a feed's draws (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.bwr)
feat(feed): each feed's summary states its frames' lateness as a distribution, and logs the histogram it read it from (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.bwr)
docs(spec): A-4 stands on three conditions, and A-1's in-process baseline is recorded (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.bwr)

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.222.1

## [1.222.1](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.222.0...v1.222.1) (2026-11-16)

### Bug Fixes

* **collector:** tok/s lasts a whole turn, speed configs load again, a quiet session logs nothing and every provider closes (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.xae) ([#761](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/761)) ([3d8af44](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/3d8af440ea7624f469ec0bdb62620124ea12c90f))

fix(usage): a forked or resumed session's copied history counts once, in the session it was copied from (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.au0)

Claude Code marks each entry it copies into a fork's transcript with
forkedFrom. Across the 80 newest transcripts here, all 947 response ids
held by more than one file have exactly one unmarked copy, so the fold
skips copied entries and needs no set of response ids.
